title: Keyturn Trip Booking Mileage Tariff: Included Miles, Overage Rates and Extra-Mile Blocks
content:
The mileage figures a Keyturn Trip Booking is metered on belong to its rate plan. This tariff card carries, for each of the six plans, the miles included for each 24 hours of reserved time, the ceiling on the included miles one reservation can accumulate, whether the plan can waive mileage metering altogether, the price of each mile driven beyond the allowance, the miles beyond the allowance that are not charged, and the size and price of one purchasable block of extra miles.

| Figure | Hourly | Daily | Weekend | Weekly | Monthly | Extended Stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Included miles for each 24 hours | 60 | 200 | 250 | 175 | 125 | 100 |
| Ceiling on included miles for one reservation | 120 | 1400 | 750 | 1225 | 3750 | 12000 |
| Mileage metering can be waived | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Price of each mile beyond the allowance (USD) | 0.45 | 0.42 | 0.40 | 0.36 | 0.32 | 0.28 |
| Miles beyond the allowance not charged | 5 | 10 | 15 | 25 | 50 | 75 |
| Size of one block of extra miles | 50 | 100 | 150 | 250 | 500 | 1000 |
| Price of one block of extra miles (USD) | 21.50 | 38.00 | 55.00 | 82.00 | 145.00 | 265.00 |

### Points of judgement on the figures

*Which plans can waive metering?* Only the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan carries the switch that allows mileage metering to be waived altogether. The other five plans meter every reservation.

*Do the daily allowance and the ceiling move together up the ladder?* They do not. The daily allowance peaks on the Keyturn Weekend Rate Plan at 250 miles and falls away on the longer plans, while the per-reservation ceiling rises steadily with the length of the plan, from 120 miles on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan to 12000 miles on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan.

*What is the grace figure?* It is the miles beyond the allowance that are not charged, stated in miles, and it widens with the plan from 5 miles to 75 miles.
